name: Evolve User data model and update 4 service consumers
description: Split User.name into firstName and lastName in src/models/user.ts, update auth, email, analytics, and export services.

inputs.task_prompt: Update the User interface in src/models/user.ts: replace name: string with firstName: string and lastName: string. Add an exported helper getFullName(user: User): string. Update the 4 consumer services (auth.ts, email.ts, analytics.ts, export.ts) to adhere to the new model. All tests in test/user-services.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: User interface has firstName and lastName instead of name
auth.ts registers user with firstName and lastName
